method: Binary grading against the authored assertions. A case passes only when every assertion passes. The grader had access to the arm label, so this is not blinded.

gateway-config-schema-first.notes: Baseline was cautious but omitted current-config inspection, exact authorization, and the skill's one-field first-class patch workflow.

gateway-restart-safety.notes: Baseline produced a generic restart plan but missed the 19/19 gate, first-class restart, continuation, and exact /new then ping/pong proof.

gateway-model-diagnosis.notes: Baseline routed to openai-docs and diagnosed Codex configuration instead of OpenClaw session/router override locations.

gateway-negative-copy-edit.notes: Both arms handled the unrelated writing task without invoking gateway ceremony.

publishing-preflight-plan.notes: Baseline checked approval and artifact identity but missed supportable-claim/privacy/visual gates and duplicate prevention.

publishing-visual-rejection.notes: The skill caught all stated defects but did not restate the full warm-paper, black-ink, orange-accent replacement direction.

publishing-ambiguous-retry.notes: Baseline avoided a blind retry but did not require both local logs and source-system status before live verification.

publishing-negative-summary.notes: Both arms returned the private one-sentence summary with no publishing workflow.

cv-title-only-block.notes: Both correctly blocked title-only generation; neither explicitly stated the no-fabrication rule in the final response.

cv-ats-floor-block.notes: The baseline said proceed at 79%; the skill enforced the mandatory 82% floor.

cv-applied-duplicate-block.notes: The scenario was sufficiently explicit that both arms blocked regeneration and resend.

cv-negative-bio-edit.notes: Both arms handled the unrelated bio edit without activating the CV pipeline.
